dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Oh, my, Lady Nefer! Are you looking to buy? Whatever you want, I'll give you a discount!

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: ...Might I also inquire about the antique buyers you were helping me find...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've already sent representatives to contact them. As soon as there's news, I'll let you know.

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: O—Okay... Wonderful! There really is nothing you can't do, Lady Nefer!

dialogues.speaker: Jujian
dialogues.text: Once everything's settled, I'll pick out the best item I have as a gift to show my gratitude!
